mechanism: Both agents are nephrotoxic and can cause acute kidney injury; foscarnet may increase piperacillin levels through reduced renal clearance, and concurrent use elevates risk of crystalline nephropathy and electrolyte abnormalities.
action: Monitor renal function closely (baseline and every 2-3 days), ensure adequate hydration, consider alternative antibiotic if possible, and assess for signs of acute kidney injury; dose adjustments may be necessary based on creatinine clearance.
